recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source change is needed for FHIR-14036 unless OO opens a new enhancement for additional non-patient examples beyond the current Location and Group examples.
issue_request: FHIR-14036 asked OO to call out that Observation can have subjects other than Patient and to add real-world examples such as location/physical-object testing, including oyster testing and possible herd/group examples.
initial_application: Source history shows direct GF#14036 application: f35b3850a7 added the oyster-farm Location example and examples-page section, and 8e754bdb77 added the herd Group example and examples-page section. A later GF#14036 build-fix commit was not substantively about this request.
additional_context: Observation is active in the current build. Observation.subject now lists many non-Patient target types, and later final Observation issues FHIR-29032 and FHIR-31081 broadened Scope and Usage to tests on products, substances, and environments. Community searches found no contrary Zulip or Confluence evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because current source already has Scope and Usage text that is no longer patient-centric, plus active Location and Group subject examples in the Observation examples surface.

related_jiras.note: Published Observation issue that broadened Scope and Usage to product and substance testing and helps explain the current non-patient narrative.
Applied Observation issue that further broadened Scope and Usage to environments.
